The Neutral / No Edge call is a miss under the below-expected-move convention (19.31% >> 13.4% unsigned expected), though it lands inside the wide 6.7-27.8% band -- the 'stock moved hard, panel had no view' case, and the specific red-team reversal mechanism (beat overshadowed by cautious guide) did not fire; this time guidance was raised, not hedged. The stage-2 preliminary read (-20, bearish) also called the wrong direction -- neither the panel nor the cheap read anticipated the guidance raise.

The Neutral / No Edge call scores a hit under the below-expected-move convention (0.35% << 10.8% unsigned expected) and this is the panel's best-calibrated call to date: the split panel (4 up / 3 down, disparity 28.0) explicitly flagged that direction hinged on the credit/margin guide rather than the near-certain headline beat, and that is exactly what happened -- the initial beat-driven pop faded as the market digested guidance, consistent with (if not a full instance of) the red team's own cited Feb-2026 beat-yet-fell precedent, without the stock actually turning negative. Sign-wise this is technically a miss against the stage-2 preliminary read (-18, bearish) since the close came in fractionally positive, but at 0.35% the outcome is inside rounding/noise of a dead flat print -- functionally a draw, not a real directional call by either method.
